iPhone 18 Pro Pre-Orders Potentially Delayed to September 12

Pre-orders for the upcoming iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max models may be postponed to September 12. This potential delay has emerged in recent coverage concerning the release timeline for Apple's new devices. Additionally, the iPhone 17 Pro Max has reportedly seen price reductions globally in anticipation of the iPhone 18 launch.
